a.discount_desc: Reduces what is claimed on this invoice only. The reason is required and may not exceed the invoice itself; paid and special invoices cannot be discounted.
a.discount_amount_hint: Total discount on this invoice — 0 removes an existing one. Defaults to the invoice's own charge (a free month).
pl.subsidies_hint: An exemption or a permanent percent written into this month's invoices
pl.exempt_hint: What exempt houses would have been charged this cycle
